description: This file defines the OnFoldListener interface, which declares callback methods for folding events in a folding layout component.

classes.name: OnFoldListener
classes.description: An interface that provides callback methods for fold state changes in a folding layout component.

methods.name: onStartFold
methods.description: Invoked when folding begins, transitioning from an unfolded to a folded state.

methods.name: onEndFold
methods.description: Invoked when folding ends, transitioning from a folded to an unfolded state.
